title: Rook Into the Corner
setup: Black's bishop sits on d1 and its rooks stand on g6 and e3 — your king looks distinctly airy.
hint: Do not answer the threats. Find the check that forces a black piece onto the rank your rook will own.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rc8+}} ignores every threat against your king. {{Re8}} is the only reply, and now {{Rxe8#}} is mate because the rook takes the whole eighth rank and the pawns take the rest. Tempo beats material when the tempo ends the game.
